title: A Walk Through History - The University of Sydney Campus Heritage Tour
description:
Tour the historic University of Sydney campus in celebration of our 175th anniversary, guided by alumnus John Bell - acclaimed actor, director and founder of Bell Shakespeare.

From the iconic Quadrangle to the remarkable students and staff who have shaped the world, this tour explores our heritage and legacy as Australia's first university, founded on principles of merit and equity in 1850.

Discover the heritage of our sandstone buildings and the long history of innovation and impact that connects generations of University of Sydney graduates.

title: Steve Jobs' 2005 Stanford Commencement Address (with intro by President John Hennessy)
description:
Help us caption and translate this video on Amara.org: http://www.amara.org/en/v/tx/
